hindi: विजिगीषु का समुत्थान दो प्रकार का है: वन आदि से आरम्भ होने वाला और एक ग्राम आदि से आरम्भ होने वाला।
english: The conqueror's rising is of two kinds: that beginning with the forest, and that beginning with a single village.
notes: samutthāna rendered "rising" (lit. standing up together); ādika = beginning with / and so on. The "-" is the e-text dash introducing the two kinds.

hindi: और इसका लाभ तीन प्रकार का है: नया, पूर्व और पैतृक।
english: And his acquisition is of three kinds: new, previous and ancestral.
notes: The word trividhaś ends with ś before ca-asya (sandhi: trividhaḥ ca). Closing iti marks the end of the list and is not rendered separately. bhūta-pūrva = "formerly been"; taken as the acquisition held before (see 13.5.22).

hindi: नया लाभ प्राप्त करके वह शत्रु के दोषों को अपने गुणों से ढके, और गुणों को गुणों की दुगुनी मात्रा से।
english: Having obtained a new acquisition, he should cover over the enemy's faults with his own virtues, and [the enemy's] virtues with a doubling of virtues.
notes: para = "other", rendered "enemy" as throughout this book. The second clause is elliptical: guṇān is taken as the enemy's virtues, covered by a doubling of (his own) virtues; the text does not say whose virtues.

words.gloss: by acts of favour for their own dharma and action, of exemption, gift and honour
what is dear and beneficial to the constituent elements

hindi: अपने धर्म और कर्म के प्रति अनुग्रह, परिहार, दान और मान के कर्मों द्वारा वह प्रकृतियों के प्रिय और हित का अनुसरण करे।
english: And by acts of favour for their own dharma and action, of exemption, of gift and of honour, he should follow what is dear and beneficial to the constituent elements.
notes: The long compound is ambiguous: "sva-dharma-karma-anugraha" may be favour for their own dharma and action (as taken), or favour consonant with the action of their own dharma. prakṛti is rendered "constituent element" per the glossary, though here the sense may be the subjects generally. anuvarteta lit. "should follow, conform to".

hindi: और जैसी बातचीत हुई थी वैसे वह कृत्य-पक्ष को अपनी ओर करे, और आगे प्रयास किए हुए को भी।
english: And he should win over the party of the seducible as was discussed, and further [one] who has made effort.
notes: upagrāhayet (causative of upa-√grah) lit. "should cause to be taken up/held"; "win over" is the nearest literal sense. The second clause has no stated noun; kṛta-prayāsam is taken as a person or group (the one who has made effort). kṛtya-pakṣa per glossary.

words.gloss: conduct contrary to the constituent elements

hindi: क्योंकि अविश्वास अपने और दूसरों के लिए विसंवाद उत्पन्न करने वाला होता है, और प्रकृतियों के विरुद्ध आचरण भी।
english: For distrust becomes a cause of discord for his own people and for others, and [so does] conduct contrary to the constituent elements.
notes: visaṃvādaka: "causing discord / disagreement"; an alternative is "deceiving, belying". Supplied "[so does]" because the verb bhavati is shared. Here prakṛti may also mean the natural dispositions of the people; glossary rendering kept.

words.gloss: likeness in character, dress, speech and conduct

hindi: इसलिए वह शील, वेश, भाषा और आचार में समानता प्राप्त करे।
english: Therefore he should attain likeness in character, dress, speech and conduct.

text_flags.why: possible: single ch for cch (older orthography, as in chādayet / prayacchet elsewhere in the chunk)

notes: The text does not say with whom the likeness is to be attained; nothing supplied.

words.gloss: in the deities of the region, gatherings, festivals and outings

hindi: और देश के देवताओं, समाजों, उत्सवों और विहारों में भक्ति का अनुसरण करे।
english: And in the deities of the region, in gatherings, festivals and outings, he should keep up devotion.

text_flags.why: likely typo: smāja for samāja ("gathering"); the Devanagari also has स्माज

notes: anuvarteta lit. "should follow, conform to"; "keep up" chosen for bhaktim anuvarteta. deśa-daivata may also be read "the deity of each region".

words.gloss: among the chiefs of regions, villages, castes and saṅghas

hindi: और देश, ग्राम, जाति और संघ के मुख्य जनों के बीच गुप्तचर निरन्तर शत्रु का अपचार दिखाएँ, और उन पर स्वामी का माहाभाग्य और भक्ति, तथा स्वामी का विद्यमान सत्कार भी।
english: And among the chiefs of regions, villages, castes and saṅghas, secret agents should constantly show the enemy's misconduct, and the king's greatness and devotion towards them, and the king's honouring [of them] that exists.
notes: Ambiguity: "bhaktiṃ ca teṣu svāminaḥ" is taken as the king's devotion towards them; it could also be their devotion to the king. "svāmi-satkāraṃ vidyamānam" lit. "the king's honour that exists"; "[of them]" supplied. para = enemy. sattrin = secret agent per glossary. jāti rendered "castes" (could be "communities").

words.gloss: with enjoyments, exemptions, protection and supervision

hindi: और उचित भोग, छूट, रक्षा और निरीक्षण के द्वारा इनका उपभोग करे।
english: And with fitting enjoyments, exemptions, protection and supervision he should enjoy these.
notes: Obscure: bhuñjīta (√bhuj "enjoy") with bhoga in the instrumental. Rendered literally; alternatives are "make use of", "maintain", "rule". enān is taken to refer to the chiefs of the previous unit. parihāra = exemption.

words.gloss: worship of all deities and hermitages
of men of learning, speech, dharma and valour
gifts of land and wealth and exemptions
of the poor, the helpless and the sick

hindi: वह सब देवताओं और आश्रमों की पूजा करवाए; विद्या, वाक्, धर्म और शौर्य वाले पुरुषों को भूमि और धन के दान तथा छूट दिलवाए; सब बन्धनों से मुक्ति और दीन, अनाथ तथा रोगियों पर अनुग्रह भी करवाए।
english: He should have worship of all deities and hermitages [done], and have gifts of land and wealth and exemptions [granted] to men of learning, speech, dharma and valour; [he should have] release from all bonds [done] and favour to the poor, the helpless and the sick.
notes: kārayet is understood with the last two items. vidyā-vākya-dharma-śūra-puruṣa: "men of learning, speech, dharma and valour" (vākya may be "eloquence"; the members may qualify puruṣa as "learned, eloquent, righteous, brave men"). bandhana lit. "binding"; "bonds" kept literal (imprisonment is likely).

words.gloss: on the nakṣatras of the king and the country

hindi: चातुर्मास्यों में आधे मास तक घात न होना, पूर्णिमाओं पर चार रात तक, और राजा तथा देश के नक्षत्रों पर एक रात तक।
english: At the Cāturmāsyas, non-slaughter lasting half a month; on full-moon days, [lasting] four nights; on the nakṣatras of the king and the country, [lasting] one night.

text_flags.why: possible: long ū unexpected in "lasting four nights" (catur + rātrika); may be a variant spelling

notes: The verb (kārayet, as in 13.5.11) and the object of the non-slaughter (living beings) are not stated; nothing supplied except "[lasting]". rāja-deśa-nakṣatra: "the king's and the country's nakṣatras" (birth-stars), not "nakṣatras of the king and country" as a single compound; Cāturmāsya = the four-monthly seasonal observances, kept as a name.

words.gloss: the killing of yoni and young

hindi: वह योनि और बाल के वध तथा पुंस्त्व के उपघात का निषेध करे।
english: He should prohibit the killing of yoni and young, and injury to virility.
notes: Obscure: yoni lit. "womb, source"; it may mean females (female animals) or those in the womb; bāla = young / children. Rendered literally and left unresolved. Both the creatures concerned and the sense of puṃstva-upaghāta (e.g. castration) are not stated in the text.

words.gloss: harmful to the treasury and army
a procedure in conformity with dharma

hindi: जिस आचरण को वह कोश और सेना के लिए हानिकारक अथवा अत्यन्त अधर्ममय माने, उसे हटाकर धर्मसम्मत व्यवहार स्थापित करे।
english: And whatever practice he considers harmful to the treasury and army, or most unrighteous, that he should remove, and establish a procedure in conformity with dharma.
notes: daṇḍa = army per glossary. caritra = conduct / practice / custom. vyavahāra may be "legal procedure" or "dealing".

words.gloss: of the chiefs of fort, country and army

hindi: चोर-प्रकृति वालों और म्लेच्छ जातियों का अनेक स्थानों में स्थान-परिवर्तन करवाए, और दुर्ग, राष्ट्र और सेना के मुख्य जनों का भी।
english: He should have a change of place [made] for those of thievish nature and for mleccha tribes, located in several places, and also for the chiefs of the fort, the country and the army.
notes: anekastham ("located in more than one place") is taken with sthāna-viparyāsam, i.e. the change of place is a scattering over several places; the exact sense is uncertain. cora-prakṛti: prakṛti here = nature (cf. glossary 8.2). mleccha kept untranslated. durga-rāṣṭra-daṇḍa-mukhyānām: fort, country, army as in glossary.

words.gloss: of those supported by the enemy

hindi: शत्रु द्वारा सहारा पाए हुए मन्त्रियों और पुरोहितों का शत्रु के सीमान्त प्रदेशों में अनेक स्थानों पर निवास करवाए।
english: And for ministers and chaplains supported by the enemy, he should have a residence made in several places in the enemy's frontier regions.

text_flags.why: possible: parā for para ("by the enemy"); long ā is not expected before upagṛhīta

notes: upagṛhīta = taken up / supported / embraced (cf. glossary upagṛhya); "won over" would be an interpretation. Reading of parā.upagṛhītānām depends on the suspected typo. pratyanta = frontier.

hindi: हानि करने में समर्थ लोगों को अथवा अनुक्षियतः लोगों को, स्वामी के विनाश पर, वह गुप्त दण्ड से शान्त करे।
english: He should pacify by secret punishment those capable of harm, or the anukṣiyataḥ (obscure), on the destruction of [their] master.
notes: Obscure. anukṣiyataḥ is a form I cannot place with confidence (anu-√kṣi, "dwell near" or "waste away after"); it is left as printed. The construction of bhartṛ-vināśam is also uncertain: object of praśamayet, or "on account of the destruction of the master". Other readings are possible; do not rely on this translation.

hindi: अपने देश के लोगों को अथवा शत्रु द्वारा निकाले हुए लोगों को वह हटाए गए स्थानों में बसाए।
english: He should settle those of his own country, or those shut out by the enemy, in places that have been cleared.
notes: aparuddha: the glossary sense "prince in disfavour" is not clearly intended here (no prince is mentioned); rendered "shut out" and the technical sense is possible. apavāhita-sthāna lit. "places carried away / removed"; "cleared" is the nearest rendering, and what was cleared is not stated. "pareṇa" = by the enemy.

words.gloss: what is to be taken back
the giving of treasury and army

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. ātm. upa-√kṛ

hindi: और जो उसके कुल का व्यक्ति पुनः लेने योग्य को ले सकने में समर्थ हो, अथवा सीमान्त वन में स्थित कुलीन व्यक्ति पीड़ा देने में समर्थ हो, उसे वह गुणहीन भूमि दे, अथवा गुणवती भूमि का चौथा भाग, कोश और सेना के दान को निश्चित करके, जिससे उपकार करता हुआ वह पौर और जानपदों को कुपित करे।
english: And whoever is a kinsman of his family able to take back what is to be taken back, or, being well-born and stationed in a frontier forest, able to harass — to him he should give land lacking good qualities, or a fourth part of [land] having good qualities, after fixing the giving of treasury and army, whereby, doing a favour, he would anger the citizens and country people.
notes: Obscure in several places: (1) tat in tat-kulīna is the enemy king (his family). (2) kośa-daṇḍa-dānam: the giving of treasury and army, direction unstated (to or by the grantee). (3) yad upakurvāṇaḥ: "whereby, doing a favour/service" is a literal reading; the sense seems to be that the grantee provokes the people (cf. next unit), but upakurvāṇa could also be "acting near/helping". (4) pratyādeya = what is to be taken back (recoverable). abhijāta = well-born per glossary. paura-jānapada = citizens/country people per glossary.

hindi: उनके कुपित होने पर उनके द्वारा इसको मरवा डाले।
english: With them angered, he should have him killed by them.
notes: Continues 13.5.19: the grantee is killed by the angered citizens and country people.

hindi: प्रकृतियों द्वारा जिसके विरुद्ध पुकार की गई हो, उसे वह हटा दे, अथवा विनाश वाले प्रदेश में बसाए।
english: One who is denounced by the constituent elements he should remove, or he should settle [him] in a region liable to destruction.
notes: Closing iti is not rendered; it closes the treatment of the first kind of acquisition (the new one). apanayet: "remove" (lit. lead away); "do away with" is not excluded. aupaghātika lit. "relating to destruction" (e.g. dangerous); upakruṣṭa lit. "cried out against". Here prakṛti may mean the subjects; glossary rendering kept.

hindi: पूर्व लाभ में जिस दोष के कारण विमुख हुआ था, प्रकृतियों के उस दोष को वह ढके, और जिस गुण से लौट आया था, उसे तीव्र करे।
english: In the previous [case], that fault of the constituent elements by which [it/he] had turned away he should cover over, and that virtue by which [it/he] had come back he should intensify.
notes: The subject of apavṛtta and upāvṛtta is not stated (the former holder, the constituents or the acquisition); "[it/he]" is supplied. Closing iti not rendered separately. bhūta-pūrva = the second kind of acquisition in 13.5.2.

hindi: पैतृक लाभ में वह पिता के दोषों को ढके और गुणों को प्रकट करे।
english: In the ancestral [case], he should cover over the father's faults and make [his] virtues known.
notes: Closing iti not rendered separately. "[his]" supplied: the virtues are taken as the father's. The text says pitrye ("in the ancestral") without a noun.

hindi: धर्मसम्मत आचरण जो पहले नहीं किया गया हो, और जो दूसरों द्वारा किया गया हो, उसे वह प्रवृत्त करे; अधर्मयुक्त आचरण को प्रवृत्त न करे, और जो दूसरों द्वारा किया गया हो, उसे रोक दे।
english: He should set going practice that is in conformity with dharma, [both] what has not been done [before] and what has been done by others; he should not set going [practice] not in conformity with dharma, and he should stop what has been done by others [of that kind].
notes: In line b, "kṛtaṃ ca anyaiḥ nivartayet" is taken with adharmyam: the non-dharmic practice done by others is to be stopped. The sense of akṛta ("not done before" or "not done by him") is not stated.
